product_metadata.title: OIKA Plastic Hangers 50 Pack Dry Wet Clothes Hangers with Super Non-Slip Pads 0.2" Thickness 16.5 Inch Space Saving Gray
features: ★Material, dimension and max weight: our OIKA 50 pack coat hangers is made of good plastic which with a dimension of 16.5" x 8.4" x 0.2" in a Single unit. This type of material and dimension design makes it strong enough to hold 11 pounds

★Special from other plastic hangers: Upgraded Rubber Stripes Non-Slip on the hangers shoulder keep clothes from sliding off, while the grips on the pant bar keeps Pants in place and wrinkle free , 360° rotating hooks minimize your hassles
★Space saving:Built-in horizontal accessory bar allows you to hold ties, scarves and necklaces with your clothes all together in one hanger, The best way to store your wardrobe.
★Wet and dry:The OIKA Suit Hangers will work perfectly for all types of wet and dry fabrics and can also handle spaghetti straps, silk and chiffon.
★Good Customer Service:If there are any problems,please feel free to contact us,we will try our best service to solve your any problems.
